verdict.rationale: Kit ships core 'Visual Automations' plus RSS campaigns and webhooks that react to events without manual polling, and its MCP server explicitly lets an AI agent 'read and write to a creator's Kit account on their behalf,' enabling an AI-native user to configure these automations via natural language. However, the evidence never details how automation triggers/conditions are set or shows an agent actually building a persistent background workflow end-to-end. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of automation trigger/condition setup via API/MCP, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully creating a running autonomous automation.
